data.one_liner: A Dart cookie manager for HTTP requests with in‑memory and persistent storage.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes to save, load, and delete cookies according to RFC policies. Supports both volatile (CookieJar) and file‑based (PersistCookieJar) storage, and works with HttpClient and dio.
use_when: You need automatic cookie handling for HTTP requests
You want persistent cookies across app restarts
You work with dio or HttpClient and need a simple cookie jar
avoid_when: You require a full‑featured HTTP client (use dio or http directly)
You need advanced cookie jar features like encryption not provided
strengths: Supports both in‑memory and file persistence
Works on mobile, desktop, and web
weaknesses: Limited to cookie management only, no request/response handling
No built‑in encryption or secure storage for cookies

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides its own interceptor for cookie handling and a full HTTP client

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight HTTP client; you can manage cookies manually or with other packages
